title: 自研 Harness：用通用协议桥看清一次工具闭环

audiences: 正在开发自研 Agent，希望先核对请求与工具闭环的开发者
需要检查 OpenAI Responses 或 Anthropic Messages 兼容层的 Harness 作者
第一次使用 pma observe、但不需要专用 adapter 的用户
teaching_contract.question: 不开发专用 PMA adapter，怎样先看清自研 Harness 发出的模型请求、工具结果和原始协议？
teaching_contract.takeaway: pma observe 只在 child 进程覆写指定 base URL；PMA 根据实际 wire path 与 body 识别协议，并把两次 Request 的工具调用、结果回传、最终回答、Metadata、协议视图和 Raw 连成证据链。
explicit_limits: The generic bridge proves captured HTTP exchange, not Harness-specific permission semantics.
It does not infer Skill, command, compaction, resume, or subagent behavior from the Source name.
Deterministic responses demonstrate Viewer and protocol behavior, not remote model quality.
Header redaction does not make arbitrary request bodies safe to publish.
OpenAI Responses wire data uses typed Items; assistant and tool labels shown by the Viewer are a semantic projection, not native roles on function_call or function_call_output Items.
The chapter does not claim that every OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic-compatible service implements the official schema perfectly.

facts: Both Sources were generated by the real pma observe wrapper.
OpenAI and Anthropic each contain one Turn, two Requests, one list_directory call, one matched result, and one final answer.
The OpenAI Source uses /v1/responses and the Anthropic Source uses /v1/messages.
The child-only base URL override disappears after the child exits; both Sources are stopped and retain their Trace.
The Source label does not select a protocol; protocol projection comes from captured wire evidence.
Authorization and x-api-key headers are persisted as [REDACTED:header].

production.audio: not_started; handled by the separate voice-tuning workflow

privacy.paths: only the fixed disposable /private/tmp/pma-custom-harness-demo/public-project path is visible
privacy.request_body: public deterministic Chinese teaching instructions and a directory-list task only
privacy.headers: placeholder authorization and x-api-key values are redacted before persistence

visual_review.raw_frame_result: passed for exact 1920x1080 dimensions, full three-pane layout, protocol-specific themes, zero horizontal overflow, and fixed disposable paths
visual_review.annotation_result: passed: all 25 timeline-declared states were rendered and visually inspected at 1920x1080 and 1024x576; badges are centered, subtitles stay bottom-centered, focus frames do not cover the evidence, and progressive states retain, dim, or replace earlier markers according to the narrated relationship
review_notes: The first Source run exposed the repository workspace path in Raw and was rejected before publication.
The demo was regenerated with the child cwd fixed to /tmp/pma-custom-harness-demo/public-project; all eight saved raw frames show only that disposable path.
OpenAI frames use the Codex theme and Anthropic frames use the Claude theme.
All screenshots use an exact 1920x1080 browser viewport with no document overflow.
Right-pane tabs remain comfortably spaced at full desktop width instead of filling the row.

The OpenAI input/output comparison crossfades from the three input Items to the final Assistant message; the Anthropic tool_use region is retained and dimmed when tool_result becomes the active evidence.
No arrows were added because focus frames and progressive numbering provide a clearer route without crossing readable content.

remaining: Freeze the Chinese story only after owner review.
Do not publish local MP4 or audio files from the main repository.
